summary.text: Pepper Ottman is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 34, serving since January 2021, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Pepper Ottman assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 4, 2021, succeeding Tim Salazar.

For 2025-2026, Ottman's committee assignments include co-chair of the Mental Health & Vulnerable Adult Task Force, the House Agriculture, State and Public Lands and Water Resources Committee and the House Labor, Health and Social Services Committee.
